summary: The office in {place} can establish what one worker lost but lacks records for the rest of the crew.
realLife: Denver used a restaurant worker's own hours, tips and pay records when the business did not respond, leaving other workers' losses unconfirmed.
gates: The employer has withheld records and one worker can document their own pay.
weights: Independent records strengthen that worker's claim.
inGame: needs: available worker evidence and outstanding employer records.

turns.what: Payroll arrives after the first determination.
turns.writesBack: The office rechecks the scope of the case.
